title: Edge-to-edge member background — frozen comparison contract
representativeScenario: An Expanded Branch-like Block containing two direct member Blocks, if and else, with footers shown or hidden.
outcome: Find a quiet background treatment that makes an edge-to-edge member stack read as one container without erasing the individual Blocks.
invariants: Member layout remains a two-state Inset / Edge-to-edge structural control.
Member Blocks keep real boundaries, titles, hit targets, and direct membership.
The treatment composes with both shown and hidden member footers.
No candidate changes production code until Zach picks or explicitly accepts the provisional recommendation.
prototypeStopLine: The gallery runs the layout and footer state machine in the real SystemSketch visual idiom; tldraw editing, persistence, wiring, and production theme switching remain simulated.
axes: Which structural surface carries tone: none, shared bed, alternating body, header, or inset body field
Whether hierarchy comes from seams, luminance, repetition, or depth
How the treatment survives when footers disappear

criteria.name: Continuous-stack clarity
criteria.why: The Branch-like case should read as one solid structure at a glance.
criteria.passCondition: With Edge-to-edge selected, the two members share a clear continuous silhouette.

anchors.1: Still reads as two unrelated floating cards.
anchors.3: Reads as a stack after inspection.
anchors.5: Immediately reads as one container with internal members.

criteria.name: Member hierarchy without noise
criteria.why: Each function or arm must remain separately scannable without turning the board into a striped table.
criteria.passCondition: Both titles and boundaries are easy to follow while the background stays recessive.

anchors.1: Members blur together or the treatment dominates.
anchors.3: Boundaries are clear with some visual competition.
anchors.5: Members scan instantly and the treatment recedes.

criteria.name: Hidden-footer compatibility
criteria.why: Zach expects branch-like stacks to hide footers and still feel structurally complete.
criteria.passCondition: Turning footers off leaves intentional seams and no stranded bands.

anchors.1: The composition visibly depends on footers.
anchors.3: Still works but loses some rhythm.
anchors.5: Looks equally intentional with either footer state.

criteria.name: Theme robustness
criteria.why: SystemSketch uses host and canvas themes, so the treatment should be token-shaped rather than luminance-fragile.
criteria.passCondition: The design needs only existing surface and border roles and maintains contrast.

anchors.1: Depends on a brittle literal shade or low contrast.
anchors.5: Maps directly to existing semantic tokens.

criteria.name: Low visual weight
criteria.why: The background should support fast diagram reading rather than becoming a new notation.
criteria.passCondition: The treatment does not compete with ports, titles, or dataflow.

anchors.1: Adds a strong new pattern or accent.
anchors.5: Quiet enough to disappear during normal reading.

hardGates.name: Readable text
hardGates.passCondition: Every title stays legible in shown and hidden-footer states.

hardGates.name: Visible member boundaries
hardGates.passCondition: The if and else Blocks remain distinguishable without hover.

hardGates.name: No semantic color claim
hardGates.passCondition: No treatment introduces an accent that could be mistaken for type, state, or flow meaning.
